verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a local LLM app with an agentic harness (Bionic), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a built-in scheduler or recurring workflows. The headless llmster daemon, CLI and REST API are building blocks that an external scheduler like cron could drive, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
